title: Orders list: table with empty, loading and error states

acceptanceCriteria.text: The Orders page lists orders in a table with order ID, customer, status, total and created date, newest first.
When there are no orders, show the empty state with a 'Create order' action.
When the request fails, show a retry button.
While orders load, show skeleton rows; the skeleton must appear only after 300 ms.

expectedBehaviors.expected: Empty state with a 'Create order' button
Error banner with a Retry button that re-requests orders
